about: The lightweight budgets' baselines (plan section 11): every accepted size of Featherweight.exe and the portable zip per compiler, and every accepted set of timings per computer, each with why. scripts\budgets.ps1 checks a build against the last entries and adds new ones with -Record; see tests\budgets\README.md.

sizes.reason: 0.9.4 as released, built by scripts\release.ps1: where the ledger starts.

D0 host and foundations: Direct3D 11 swap chain, the Painter and vector printing, the new widgets with UI Automation, side panel, status bar, command search, start screen and fwpkg. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Timings 19-37 % faster than 0.9.4, memory within 3 %.

D1: the read-only Word document tab: the fwdoc model and .docx reader, fwtext line layout and hyphenation patterns, fwdraw DrawingML/VML pictures, pagination, and DocView with find, selection, comments, tracked changes, links and vector printing. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Exe 2.64 MB (budget 4 MB). A 300-page .docx is fully paginated in under 0.8 s at 61 MB; PDF timings unchanged.

D1 exit check (non-layout criteria): the Word document viewer as merged in d0/host c71b693, plus the model fixes fuzzing found. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Exe 2.77 MB (budget 4 MB). Timings kept from the aaf2a08 entry: re-measured on 2026-11-05 at 12:40 while other sessions loaded the PC (unchanged PDF scenarios 25-60 % slower too). Absolute D1 budgets met even then: 300-page .docx paginated in 0.88 s (budget 3 s), 61 MB.

D1 final: the pagination merged in d0/host 6f495ca (91.7 % of page counts, 95.2 % of lines match Word), with the model fixes from fuzzing. Shipped build. Exe 2.82 MB (budget 4 MB). 300-page .docx paginated in 0.80 s, 61 MB, idle 0, measured under load from other sessions; timings kept from the aaf2a08 entry.

D2 formatting (claude/d2-format, with claude/d2-edit 7fa93e2 merged): character and paragraph formatting, styles, lists, the format painter, Insert date and time, the toolbar's formatting groups and Word's keys (fwdoc edit/Format, Styles, Lists, TreeEdit; word/DocFormat), plus d2-edit's editor, typing, find and replace, formatted copy and paste (RTF and HTML) and relayout after edits. Shipped build. Exe 3.20 MB (budget 4 MB). Formatting on a 278-page document: median 12 ms, worst 24 ms (fwtool typing). Timings not re-recorded: measured under load from other sessions (PDF scenarios, untouched, 25-40 % slower too); side by side with claude/d2-proof's build under the same load, launch memory and times match.

D2 files: new document, safe saving (verified temporary file, ReplaceFileW), backups of originals, DPAPI recovery autosaves, the ~$ owner file and change detection. Saving links the .docx writer, the zip writer and deflate, which the read-only tab never called. crypt32.dll is delay-loaded. Opening timings against d0/host 6f495ca on the same PC: report.docx window 43.9 vs 43.7 ms, ready 116 vs 119 ms; nothing runs while idle (the autosave timer runs only while a tab has unsaved changes).

D2 edit API in the document tab: doc::edit::Editor (transactions, undo and redo; claude/d2-edit 047ee73) and laying out again after an edit (fc27d1f) join the exe now that DocView owns an editor, wired to modified, Save and recovery.

D2 proofing (claude/d2-proof): spelling with Windows' own spell checker (no dictionaries shipped), AutoCorrect, word count, the selection's language, squiggles, suggestions and the Word count dialog, +109 KB. It includes D2 editing from claude/d2-edit 4bb78c1 (+173 KB), which has no entry of its own. Timings kept: the PC was loaded by other sessions. A/B on this PC: spelling adds about 37 ms to report.docx's ready (loading the checker and checking the first two pages, after the first page shows) and nothing while idle.

D2 integrated (claude/d2-integration 4b8682b): editing, formatting, files, proofing and incremental relayout together, each recorded on its own branch (formatting with editing 3.36 MB, files 2.99 MB, proofing +109 KB). The torture harness is fwtool only. Exe 3.47 MB of the 4 MB budget, +800 KB over D1 final. Timings kept: the PC is loaded by other sessions.

D2 on the real display (5120x1440). The previous D1 timing baseline was measured while Roy's session was disconnected, on Windows' 448-px placeholder display, so every window was tiny. Measured side by side on this display, D1 (2006c18) and D2 (e325735) differ by 1-2 ms (launch ready 83.8 vs 83.4 ms, big-600-pages 133.4 vs 132.9 ms); this entry is the new baseline for this PC.

D3 headers: headers and footers in place, page numbers, links, bookmarks, navigation pane, formatting marks (+155 KB); timings kept, the PC was loaded (side by side with the integration build: same launch memory 22.0 MB, PDF opens within noise)

D3 pictures (claude/d3-pictures): insert from a file, paste and drop; select, move, resize, rotate, crop, wrap, alt text, reset, with exact undo; the Picture panel; saves leave out unused pictures. Picture editing is about 140 KB of code (Pictures.obj 86 KB, DocPictures.obj 54 KB) spread over many functions; a favor-small-code pragma saved only 6 KB, so not used. Exe 3.82 MB of the 4 MB budget.

D3 integrated (claude/d3-int d6587f2): tables (d3-tables), pictures (d3-pictures), page setup, sections, columns and breaks (d3-page), headers and footers (d3-headers), the ruler (d3-ruler) and the torture findings' fixes (d3-torture), with D2 integration a54f4c9. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF, V8). Exe 4.16 MB (4,364,800 bytes) of the 2.0 budget, under 7 MB (decision 22): +536 KB over D3 headers (5712c69), +532 KB over D3 pictures (70d8d52) alone. Timings not re-recorded: the PC is loaded by other sessions.

D3 audit gaps (d3-ruler 11ea731): tab leaders from the ruler's menu and the Tabs panel, Modify style and New style, and theme fonts and colors in the font box and palette, about +64 KB. The other +21 KB since d6587f2 is D3's later torture fixes and D2's merges (autolink, change case, search by whole words). Size only: timings weren't re-recorded while other sessions load the PC.

D4 shapes (claude/d4-shapes 08bd450): text boxes edited and written into each copy (DrawingML and VML), shapes (text box, rectangle, rounded rectangle, oval, line, arrow, callout: insert, move, resize, turn, wrap, fill, outline, text), text and picture watermarks, and the Shape and Watermark panels: +153 KB over its base d3-int d98a735 (4,462,080). The other +9.5 KB since e53a4cd is D3's later commits. Size only: timings weren't re-recorded while a fuzz run loads the PC.

D4 Export PDF (claude/d4-pdf): draw::PdfDocument and PdfPainter, a PDF 1.7 writer for the Painter (text as subset TrueType/CFF fonts with ToUnicode, paths, gradients, clips, transparency groups, JPEG passed through, others Flate), soft shadows as pictures, links, outline and info; a self-written sfnt subsetter; File > Export PDF for Word documents and a flattened copy for PDF tabs. +196 KB over d3-int d98a735 (4,462,592 bytes): Pdf.obj 143 KB, Sfnt.obj 20 KB, DocPdf.obj 15 KB, the rest 18 KB. Already taken out: std::to_chars for doubles (-106 KB of tables) and a templated Paint (-34 KB); favoring small code saved only 5 KB, so not used. Shipped build. Exe 4.45 MB of the 2.0 budget (7 MB). Size only: timings not re-recorded while other sessions load the PC.

D4 so far (claude/d4-int 8104efa): Export PDF, a PDF backend with font subsetting, links and an outline (+309.5 KB alone); review, with comments, tracked changes and the Review pane (+173.5 KB); shapes, text boxes and watermarks (+153 KB); content controls and legacy forms (+82 KB); footnotes, endnotes and tables of contents (+78 KB); Save as RTF and plain text (+32.5 KB). Each was measured alone over d3-int d98a735 (4,462,080 bytes). Size only: timings weren't re-recorded while other sessions load the PC.

D4 complete for the final gate (claude/d4-int 0a2e934), smaller than 8104efa now that Export PDF writes numbers from integer thousandths and paints through one function. Each piece alone over d3-int d98a735 (4,462,080 bytes): Export PDF +196.5 KB (d1-text's measure at 8f9e043); review, with comments, tracked changes and the Review pane, +173.5 KB; shapes, text boxes and watermarks +153 KB; content controls and legacy forms +82 KB; footnotes, endnotes and tables of contents +78 KB; Save as RTF and plain text +32.5 KB; and the fixes since. Size only: timings weren't re-recorded while other sessions load the PC.

D3 and D4 on d0/host (70352dc): tables, pictures, page layout, headers and footers, links, review, TOC and notes, forms, shapes, Export PDF, RTF/TXT. Timings on the real display (5120x1440), the first since D2: launch and PDFs 0-13 ms faster, memory within 1 MB, typing in the 300-page document 2.0 ms typical, 17 ms worst.

D5 fwchart (budget 250 KB): column, bar, line, pie, doughnut, area and scatter charts drawn from their cached values, with titles, axes, gridlines, legends and data labels, on screen, printed and in Export PDF. +96 KB over 70352dc, which also counts the New document command and a paste fix merged since.

D5 equations (claude/d5-script): OMML shown read-only by doc/layout/Math, a TeX-style typesetter on Cambria Math's MATH table (constants, glyph variants and assemblies) for fractions, scripts, radicals, n-ary operators, delimiters, matrices, eqArr, accents, bars, functions, limits and boxes, on screen, printed and in Export PDF. +69.5 KB over d5-int 2c7f571 (5,207,552 bytes), of the piece's 300 KB budget. Size only.
D5 CFB reader and password-protected .docx (claude/d5-crypt): +70.0 KB over d5-int 2c7f571 (5,207,552), within its 80 KB budget. Size only.

D5 .odt import and templates (claude/d5-odt 0591731): +172 KB over 70352dc, a few KB of it d5-int's own New document commits. The OpenDocument text converter (src/doc/odf: styles, lists, tables, frames and pictures, notes, headers and footers, bookmarks and links, page layout, written as WordprocessingML for the .docx reader), the letter, CV and report templates built in code, template files opening as new documents, and the start screen's Templates row. Within the piece's 300 KB budget.

typing.reason: D2: incremental relayout after edits (Layout::Edited, page checkpoints, paragraph line cache). Measured with fwtool bench --typing on the Release build: keystroke to the page painted again on the GPU, at the start, middle and end of the 300-page document.

D2: typing in a table lays out only the rows it changed, and cells, notes and headers keep the lines of paragraphs laid out before. A fourth place types in the last table cell on the middle page. In the UN financial report (353 pages, one table of 225 rows), a keystroke in that table takes 2.5 ms, down from 48.
